## Type of change

<!-- Match the Conventional Commit type used in the commit message (see AGENTS.md) -->

- [ ] `feat` – new feature (minor version bump)
- [ ] `fix` – bug fix (patch version bump)
- [ ] `docs` – documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` / `perf` – internal change, no behavior change
- [ ] `test` – tests only
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` / `build` – tooling, CI, dependencies

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and match existing patterns in `contabo-mcp/src/`
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes (run from `contabo-mcp/`)
- [ ] `pnpm run pack:check` passes (run from `contabo-mcp/`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for behavior that changed
- [ ] No secrets committed (`.env`, API keys, `mcp.json` credentials)
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (see [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md))
